title: 第457章 我老婆比你漂亮第456章 休想分开我们
slug: 赵老驴和杏花村的女人们
content_zh:
推荐各位书友阅读：赵老驴和杏花村的女人们第一卷：默认第457章我老婆比你漂亮（..la）“废话，我不是说你还能说谁？”这个胖女人气冲冲的大喊。
“大妹子你误会了，我没偷拍你，再说了我才刚把手机拿出来，就算是想偷拍你也没这么快的手速啊？”赵大柱一脸无奈的说道。
“听见了吧，大家都听见了吧，这个老流氓刚刚说他想偷拍我！”
胖女人刷的一下站了起来，然后就手指着赵大柱大喊起来，刺耳的声音传遍整个公交车车厢。
于是车厢里的乘客，一下子全都朝赵大柱看了过来。
“你胡说八道什么！”
赵大柱气急败坏的站起身来呵斥道，但这个胖女人没有丝毫收敛，冷笑着说道：“我胡说八道了吗，你刚刚亲口说你想偷拍我，难道你没说这话吗？”
“你……你这是断章取义！”赵大柱怒道。
“断章取义你妈个头，你个老流氓摆明了就是要偷拍我，还死不承认……你有本事就把手机给我，让我检查检查！”胖女人不依不饶的说道。
“我的手机凭什么给你检查，你有什么资格检查？”赵大柱咬牙道。
“大家看啊，他心虚了，这个死老头刚刚就是偷拍我了，所以不敢让我检查他手机！”胖女人得意的大喊起来。
赵大柱确实不想让这个胖女人检查自己的手机。
但他没有偷拍这个胖女人，仅仅只是因为他手机里保存了许多岛国爱情动作片。
如果这些东西被翻出来，他一样会很丢脸。
可现在不让这个胖女人检查手机，他就无法澄清自己，甚至连辩解都做不到，这样一来他自然就陷入十分尴尬的境地。
车厢里的乘客也开始你一言我一语的议论起来了，纷纷说起了赵大柱的不是。
“既然你说没有偷拍人家，那就把手机给这个女的检查嘛，自证清白不就行了？”
“就是啊，这么简单的事儿何必弄的这么麻烦？”
“不敢让人检查手机，就是心里有鬼！”
“没错没错！”

听到车厢里这些乘客所说的话，胖女人顿时更得意了。
她冷笑着说道：“听到没有，你不让我检查手机就是你不对，你就是心虚！”
“我凭什么让你检查我手机？你以为你是谁？再说了你哪只眼睛看到我偷拍你了？”赵大柱气冲冲的喊道。
胖女人立即嘲讽道：“瞧瞧你那土老帽的样儿，就你这一辈子都讨不到老婆的老光棍儿，看到我这样的漂亮女人，当然就想偷拍！”
“你说什么？我娶不到老婆？我是老光棍儿？”
赵大柱听到这话顿时乐了，而且一下子就找到了反驳的机会。
然后赵大柱就接着说道：“谁告诉你我没有老婆，谁告诉你我是老光棍儿？我告诉你，我不仅有老婆，而且我老婆既年轻又漂亮，比你强了不知道多少倍！”
“吹牛谁不会啊，有本事你把你老婆叫出来给我们大家伙看看呐！”胖女人得意的说道。
赵大柱于是说道：“老婆，你还傻坐着干什么，起来给我作证啊！”
李玉娇的脸腾地一下就红了。
虽然心里羞耻的不得了，但李玉娇还是从座椅上站了起来，而且十分乖巧的搂住了赵大柱的一条胳膊。
content_en:
Recommended reading for all book friends: Zhao Laolu and the Women of Xinghua Village Volume 1: Default Chapter 457 My wife is prettier than you (..la) "Nonsense, I didn't mean who else could you say?" The fat woman shouted angrily.
"Sister, you misunderstood. I didn't secretly photograph you. Besides, I just took out my phone. Even if I wanted to secretly photograph you, I wouldn't be so fast?" Zhao Dazhu said helplessly.
"You heard it, everyone heard it, this old gangster just said he wanted to secretly film me!"
The fat woman stood up quickly, then pointed at Zhao Dazhu and shouted, the harsh sound spread throughout the bus compartment.
So all the passengers in the carriage looked towards Zhao Dazhu.
"What nonsense are you talking about!"
Zhao Dazhu stood up angrily and scolded, but the fat woman did not hold back at all. She sneered and said, "Am I talking nonsense? You just said that you wanted to secretly photograph me. Didn't you say that?"
"You...you are taking things out of context!" Zhao Dazhu said angrily.
"Taking your mother's name out of context, you old gangster made it clear that you wanted to secretly photograph me, but you still refuse to admit it... If you have the ability, just give me your phone and let me check it!" the fat woman said reluctantly.
"Why should I check my mobile phone for you? What qualifications do you have to check it?" Zhao Dazhu gritted his teeth and said.
"Look, everyone, he has a guilty conscience. This old man just secretly photographed me, so he didn't dare to let me check his phone!" The fat woman shouted proudly.
Zhao Dazhu really didn't want this fat woman to check his mobile phone.
But he didn't secretly take pictures of this fat woman, just because he saved many island country love action movies on his mobile phone.
If these things were discovered, he would be embarrassed.
But now he couldn't clarify himself or even defend himself without letting the fat woman check his phone, which naturally put him in a very embarrassing situation.
The passengers in the carriage also began to talk among themselves, and they all talked about Zhao Dazhu's faults.
"Since you said you didn't secretly take photos of others, then let this woman check her cell phone. Wouldn't it be enough to prove her innocence?"
"That's right, why does such a simple thing have to be so troublesome?"
“I don’t dare to let people check my mobile phone because I have something wrong with me!”
"That's right!"
Hearing what these passengers in the carriage said, the fat woman suddenly became even more proud.
She sneered and said, "Did you hear that? You are wrong if you don't let me check your phone. You have a guilty conscience!"
"Why should I let you check my phone? Who do you think you are? Besides, which of your eyes saw me secretly filming you?" Zhao Dazhu shouted angrily.
The fat woman immediately mocked: "Look at how old-fashioned you are. You are an old bachelor who has never been able to find a wife in your life. When you see a beautiful woman like me, of course you want to take secret photos!"
"What are you talking about? I can't get a wife? I'm an old bachelor?"
Zhao Dazhu was immediately happy when he heard this, and he immediately found an opportunity to refute.
Then Zhao Dazhu continued: "Who told you that I have no wife, and who told you that I am an old bachelor? I tell you, not only do I have a wife, but my wife is young and beautiful, and she is countless times better than you!"
"Who doesn't know how to brag? If you can, call your wife out and show us all!" the fat woman said proudly.
Zhao Dazhu then said: "Honey, why are you sitting there stupidly? Get up and testify for me!"
Li Yujiao's face suddenly turned red.
Although she was extremely ashamed, Li Yujiao stood up from her seat and hugged one of Zhao Dazhu's arms very obediently.
